thread:
incident-bot: PAGERDUTY P1 -> Spike in 429s on /v1/generate from multiple regions. Canary rollout 'quota-router-v2' in us-west-2. Pager: maya

pagerduty: on-call maya alerted (50% error rate threshold breached)

maya: oncall here, seeing lots of 429s and internal token-accounting errors in logs. About ~30% of requests returning 429 within last 2m.

trevor: I can reproduce locally against canary. Looks like exemptions table is empty for a subset of customers (internal services and enterprise tier).

samir: Was there a config shape change in v2? I remember we moved exemptions under 'routing.exemptions' not top-level.

leila: Confirming: in the canary manifest the YAML anchor for exemptions didn't resolve. That would drop all exemption rules for services that rely on 'legacy' path.

maya: Paging eng-sre + runtime. Can we triage impact quickly — are billing tokens getting debited while blocked? Customers reporting 'quota exceeded' even though they have credits.

trevor: Token-accounting emitted warnings: "owner_id missing for token batch" and then quota service returns 429. Looks like token->owner mapping failed so exemptions for internal/system tokens not applied.

samir: This explains reports of telemetry clients failing under the canary. Need immediate mitigation: rollback or flip feature flag. Which is faster?

leila: Trying flip: flag is `enable_quota_router_v2`. Attempting to flip to false now.

leila: @deploy-bot flip-flag enable_quota_router_v2 false

deploy-bot: Received request to flip feature flag 'enable_quota_router_v2' -> targeting 10% rollout groups first.

maya: Uh, the flag namespace differs in the canary, it's `quota.v2.enabled`. flip-flag didn't hit the canary hosts. Flag mismatch.

trevor: Oof. So kill-switch didn't apply because key name changed during rollout. Need manual rollback.

leila: Starting rollback now. Command:
```
deploy-bot rollback service quota-router --to-sha=sha@f9c3b2 --region=us-west-2 --force
```

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated, creating reverse deployment job (job id: job-1867504321-rollback).

maya: Routing traffic to previous version now. Watching error rates...

samir: Error rate dropping in us-west-2 -> 429s down from 32% to 6% in 30s. Some residual 429s from downstream token-accounting cache TTLs.

maya: Good. Can we validate token accounting balances? Any double-billing risk during the window?

trevor: TL;DR: tokens were not consumed (requests got 429) but accounting service logged un-attributed tokens. No double charges, but some tokens were flagged as 'orphaned' and require reconciliation.

leila: Noted. I'll open a follow-up ticket for billing reconciliation and customer outreach.

maya: Oncall handoff: I'll remain for 30m to ensure stability, then hand off to next oncall (samir). Leaving note in incident commander doc.

samir: I'll take the handoff at +30. Next steps: 1) Validate full rollback across regions, 2) run a dry config validation for exemption anchors, 3) revert canary until we fix YAML anchor resolution in the config templater.

leila: Root cause summary (preliminary): config templater introduced a change that renamed/moved the exemptions path for v2; during templating a YAML anchor wasn't expanded for a subset of releases causing exemptions to be omitted. This caused token->owner mapping failures and missing exemption checks, resulting in over-throttling for services that should be exempt.

maya: Customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers (internal monitoring + 3 paying customers) saw transient errors for ~6-10 minutes. No data loss reported. Billing team: expect a reconciliation request from ops.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed in us-west-2 (job-1867504321-rollback) -> all traffic on quota-router now on v1. Global rollout of v2 paused.

maya: Closing P1: mitigated by rollback and manual routing. I'll file a postmortem and mention the feature-flag namespace mismatch.

leila: Added postmortem draft: PM-1867504321 (will link once created). Also creating CONFIG-18675 to add static unit test for YAML anchors in templater.

samir: Thanks all. If anyone on this thread has logs or additional anomalies, paste them here. Otherwise I'll pick this up during handoff. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by maya at 1867507890
